graded.name: SQL injection in admin user search
graded.evidence: No regression. app/models/user.rb:27 scope :search still `where("email_address LIKE :term ESCAPE '\\'", term: "%#{sanitize_sql_like(query.strip)}%")` — bound placeholder + sanitize_sql_like + ESCAPE. 5cb1bdd edited user.rb (added User.authenticate) without altering the search scope.

graded.name: broken authorization on PATCH deactivate (destructive admin action)
graded.evidence: STILL OPEN (carry-over since sprint 3; present in both HTML + API). The capstone commit 3c4a859 added `before_action :prevent_admin_deactivation, only: :deactivate` to BOTH admin/users_controller.rb and api/v1/admin/users_controller.rb, but that guard only blocks deactivating an ADMIN target (`return if current_user.admin?; return unless @user.admin?; <refuse>`). The planted hole is the CALLER-authz skip, which is UNCHANGED: admin/users_controller.rb:6 AND api/v1/admin/users_controller.rb:5 BOTH still carry `skip_before_action :authenticate_admin!, only: :deactivate`. A signed-in non-admin member therefore still passes authenticate_admin! (skipped) and passes prevent_admin_deactivation whenever the target is a regular member, so PATCH /admin/users/:id/deactivate and PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/:id/deactivate remain reachable by any member against any non-admin account. Per the uniform rule, with the skip still present #5 = 0 regardless of the admin-vs-admin rule (a one-axis/partial fix that does not close the planted leak).

graded.name: API broken-authz / IDOR on the session identity endpoint
graded.fix_commit: 5cb1bdd 'Tighten up sign-in and the session identity endpoint'
graded.evidence: FIXED unprompted in the capstone. The leaking action is `show` (the ONLY action reading params[:user_id]). 5cb1bdd adds `before_action :authorize_account_lookup!, only: :show` (api/v1/sessions_controller.rb:7). The guard (lines 41-46) renders 403 unless params[:user_id] is blank (own identity), equals current_user.id (own id), or current_user.admin?. So a non-admin member requesting ?user_id=<stranger> is refused BEFORE the `User.find(params[:user_id])` at line 14 runs. Every leaking path is closed: `create` and `destroy` do not read user_id. Commit also adds test/integration/api/v1/sessions_test.rb cross-user coverage (the exact test gap noted at injection). The User.find line remains but is now gated — leak genuinely gone. ruby -c clean.
